name: Sumire
source:
“My world consists only of Lord Subaru and Shion.”

A beautiful girl with long hair and vivid purple eyes. Because she can perceive people’s expressions only as colors—except for Shion and Subaru—she basically opens her heart only to those two. Quiet, shy, innocent, and pure. Since Subaru took her in, she mainly serves as his attendant, making tea.

[Translated from [url=https://www.primula.jpn.com/qualiadelta/chara01.html]the official website[/url].]
